Erdős problem #249

The binary totient series

Is the binary Lambert series ∑ φ(n)/2n irrational?

Open Problem on GitHub
ResultsPapersLean mapWhat is checked

Results and open questions

#249. Bounded-residue series A_m are irrational for every m ≥ 3, with a complete rationality classification at dyadic moduli; this is ordinary mathematics in the short note, not Lean. The strongest checked structural result tied directly to the hypothetical rational branch is carry anti-compression: one carry would have uniformly eventually-periodic dyadic sections modulo its multiplier while retaining canonical section rank at least 2^e − 1 at every level. No finite-rank upper bound is proved, so this is a necessary consequence rather than a contradiction. The exact coefficient-kernel rank 2^e + 1 for every e ≥ 1, a finite denominator exclusion, and conditional actual-LCM and first-harmonic routes remain useful, but none supplies the missing cofinal producer.

The evaluation matrix

The two ingredients are scalar reduction and arithmetic independence. The reductions explain which sections must be dependent. The difficulty is to exclude every additional relation. We do this one coefficient at a time: an evaluation will annihilate all the other columns modulo a prime while leaving the chosen column nonzero. Thus no simultaneous primality assertion for several affine forms is needed. The local formula for 𝜑φ gives the displayed reductions. For a prime 𝑝 ∣𝑘p∣k that does not divide 𝑢u, the argument 𝑘𝑗−𝑡𝑛 +𝑢kj−tn+u is a 𝑝p-adic unit, so multiplication by 𝑘𝑡kt contributes its power of 𝑝p and one factor 1 −1/𝑝1−1/p. When 𝑝 ∣𝑢p∣u, the argument already contains 𝑝p, and only its power contributes. This gives 𝐶𝑘(𝑡,𝑢)Ck(t,u).

For independence, consider finitely many forms 𝐿𝑖(𝑛) =𝑎𝑖𝑛 +𝑏𝑖Li(n)=ain+bi with positive slopes and 𝑎𝑖𝑏𝑗 ≠𝑎𝑗𝑏𝑖aibj≠ajbi for 𝑖 ≠𝑗i≠j. A finite shift makes the intercepts positive. Write 𝐿𝑖 =𝑔𝑖𝐴𝑖Li=giAi, where 𝐴𝑖Ai is primitive. Choose an odd prime ℓℓ avoiding the slopes, all 𝑔𝑖𝜑(𝑔𝑖)giφ(gi), and the nonzero cross determinants. In row 𝑖i, choose distinct primes 𝑞𝑖𝑗 ≡1(modℓ)qij≡1(modℓ) for 𝑗 ≠𝑖j≠i, outside the same finite exceptional set, and impose

𝐿𝑗(𝑛)≡0(mod𝑞𝑖𝑗),𝐴𝑖(𝑛)≡2(modℓ).Lj(n)≡0(modqij),Ai(n)≡2(modℓ).

The Chinese remainder theorem combines these congruences. The resulting progression for 𝐴𝑖(𝑛)Ai(n) is reduced: a prime 𝑞𝑖𝑗qij dividing 𝐴𝑖(𝑛)Ai(n) would also divide the nonzero cross determinant; ℓℓ is excluded by the chosen residue; and primitivity excludes the primes of the slope. Dirichlet’s theorem supplies arbitrarily large primes 𝑝 =𝐴𝑖(𝑛)p=Ai(n) with 𝑝 ∤𝑔𝑖p∤gi. Only the selected affine form is made prime in this row. The diagonal value is 𝜑(𝑔𝑖)(𝑝 −1) ≢0(modℓ)φ(gi)(p−1)≢0(modℓ). Each off-diagonal value is divisible by ℓℓ, since 𝑞𝑖𝑗 −1qij−1 divides the corresponding totient. One evaluation per row gives

(𝜑(𝐿𝑗(𝑛𝑖)))𝑖,𝑗≡diag⁡(𝑢1,…,𝑢𝑠)(modℓ),𝑢𝑖≠0.(φ(Lj(ni)))i,j≡diag⁡(u1,…,us)(modℓ),ui≠0.

The determinant is nonzero over ℚQ.

𝑘𝑗+1𝑚+(𝑘𝑗+𝑟),𝑘∤𝑟,kj+1m+(kj+r),k∤r,

Corollary 2 (Dyadic basis). The family

{𝜑0,0,𝜑1,0}∪{𝜑𝑗,𝑟:𝑗≥1, 0<𝑟<2𝑗, 𝑟 odd},𝜑𝑗,𝑟(𝑛)=𝜑(2𝑗𝑛+𝑟),{φ0,0,φ1,0}∪{φj,r:j≥1, 0<r<2j, r odd},φj,r(n)=φ(2jn+r),

is a basis for the rational span of the full dyadic kernel. Every rational relation is generated by the scalar reductions. The complete level-zero truncation has dimension one.

Proof. Every finite subfamily lies in a sufficiently high truncation. The theorem gives its independence; the reductions give equality of the full spans. The level-zero clause is ordinary in this note; PaperCompleteR7/ArithmeticAssemblies.lean is not in this checkout. ◻

Thus the 𝑅𝑖Ri generate the integral relation module. Conversely, the coefficient at an omitted index 𝑖i in ∑ℎ𝑐ℎ𝑅ℎ∑hchRh is exactly 𝑐𝑖ci: each relation has coefficient one at its own omitted coordinate and zero at all the others. Bounded residues and rationality

The residue theorem uses the same separation principle: force neighbouring coefficients to vanish while retaining one central value.

Theorem 5. For every 𝑚 ≥3m≥3,

𝐴𝑚=∑𝑛≥1𝜑(𝑛)mod𝑚2𝑛∉ℚ.Am=∑n≥1φ(n)modm2n∉Q.

The right zero block gives |𝑇𝑁| ≤𝐶2−𝐿 <1/𝑞|TN|≤C2−L<1/q, hence 𝑇𝑁 =0TN=0. The left zero block now gives 𝑇𝑁−𝐿−1 =𝑎𝑁2−𝐿−1TN−L−1=aN2−L−1, a nonzero element of 𝑞−1ℤq−1Z with absolute value less than 1/𝑞1/q, a contradiction. The complementary rationality consequence uses the same carry for both kinds of rigidity: the same-carry rank and modular-period theorem gives rank at least 2𝑒 −12e−1 at every depth and one common eventual period for all dyadic sections modulo a fixed positive multiplier. It supplies necessary structure under rationality, not a contradiction between the two properties.

Theorem 7 (Full-depth amplification). Fix 𝑑 ≥1d≥1 and 𝑁 ≥0N≥0. If Δ𝑑(𝑁) ∉ℤΔd(N)∉Z, then every sufficiently late pair {𝑡,𝑡 +1}{t,t+1} contains an 𝑚m such that 𝐾(𝑚𝑑,𝑁,𝑚𝑑)K(md,N,md) holds. Consequently

∃𝑡≥1: 𝐾(𝑡𝑑,𝑁,𝑡𝑑)⟺Δ𝑑(𝑁)∉ℤ.∃t≥1: K(td,N,td)⟺Δd(N)∉Z.

Requiring this for every 𝑑 ≥1,𝑁 ≥0d≥1,N≥0 is equivalent to 𝑆 ∉ℚS∉Q.

The seed-to-ray step is eventual two-syndetic amplification; it is equivalent to irrationality as global full-depth equivalence.

Proof. Set 𝐹𝑡 =Δ𝑡𝑑(𝑁)Ft=Δtd(N). Equation (1) yields 𝐹𝑡+1 ≡2𝑑𝐹𝑡 +𝐹1(modℤ)Ft+1≡2dFt+F1(modZ). If 𝐾(𝑡𝑑,𝑁,𝑡𝑑)K(td,N,td) fails, (2) gives

For 𝑐 ≥0c≥0, odd 𝑣 ≥1v≥1 and a positive multiple 𝐻H of 𝜑(𝑣)φ(v), put

If 𝑆 =𝑎/(2𝑐𝑣)S=a/(2cv), then 𝑣𝑅𝑐 ∈ℤvRc∈Z and Δ𝐻(𝑐) ∈ℤΔH(c)∈Z. The residue of −𝐵𝐻,𝑐−BH,c is therefore within distance less than 𝐾K of 0(mod𝑀)0(modM), so (3) fails.

Information that does not force the gap

  1. [exact reformulation] Actual LCM orbit frontier. Let 𝐻𝑎 =lcm⁡(1,…,2𝑎)Ha=lcm⁡(1,…,2a) and 𝑅𝑎 =totientTail⁡(2𝐻𝑎) −totientTail⁡(𝐻𝑎)Ra=totientTail⁡(2Ha)−totientTail⁡(Ha). Then 𝑆S is irrational if and only if, beyond every threshold 𝑎0a0, some 𝑎 ≥𝑎0a≥a0 has 𝑅𝑎 ∉ℤRa∉Z. This is the exact cofinal nonintegrality criterion for the actual LCM diagonal, not a quantitative separation estimate and not a proof that such indices occur; the forward implication is recorded separately.

  2. [unconditional progress] Positive LCM corridor and top-edge boundary. For 𝑎 ≥8a≥8 and 𝐽 +(𝑎 +6) <2 ⋅2𝑎J+(a+6)<2⋅2a, the true translated orbit difference totientTail⁡(2𝐻𝑎 +𝐽) −totientTail⁡(𝐻𝑎 +𝐽)totientTail⁡(2Ha+J)−totientTail⁡(Ha+J) is strictly positive. If it is represented by an integer and the dyadic modulus has room for the directed endpoint strip, the carry survivor is strictly negative and the discrepancy residue is exactly the top-edge representative 2𝐾 −carry𝐾2K−carryK, lying strictly between the strip’s lower edge and 2𝐾2K. Thus the positive corridor eliminates the nonnegative true survivor but does not itself produce a central-band contradiction; an independent arithmetic exclusion of the top boundary is still required. Checked: positive corridor, negative survivor, top-edge residue.

  3. [unconditional progress] LCM factor-ideal shift-algebra no-go. For every 𝑡 ≥3t≥3, with 𝐻 =lcm⁡(1,…,𝑡)H=lcm⁡(1,…,t), there is a nonzero synthetic dyadic coboundary whose forcing letters reproduce the actual totient differences at 𝑡 −2t−2 prescribed indices and lie in the ideal generated by 𝜑(𝐻)φ(H). Every finite integer shift polynomial preserves the exact coboundary cancellation, the 𝐻H-factor ideal and all lower factor ideals, together with uniform state and letter bounds. A sparse-anchor variant also preserves every prescribed whole-ray anchor. Hence factor ideals, finite shift-algebra closure and these bounds cannot by themselves force a contradiction. The witness is synthetic: its letters are not claimed to be actual totient differences, nonlinear combinations are outside the theorem, and no cofinal family of certificates follows. Checked: finite shift-algebra no-go.

The long record supplies a rational control with 𝑐(𝑛) =𝜑(𝑛)c(n)=φ(n) for odd 𝑛n, |𝑐(𝑛) −𝜑(𝑛)| ≤2|c(n)−φ(n)|≤2 for even 𝑛n, 0 ≤𝑐(𝑛) ≤𝑛0≤c(n)≤n, and

∑𝑛≥1𝑐(𝑛)2−𝑛=54.∑n≥1c(n)2−n=54.

It has an integral tempered carry with dyadic rank at least 2𝑒 −12e−1 at every level. Thus the same lower bound for a hypothetical totient carry is compatible with rationality. For one fixed prime 𝑝p and integer-valued 𝑔g, the exact laws 𝑔(𝑝𝑛) =𝑝𝑔(𝑛)g(pn)=pg(n) when 𝑝 ∣𝑛p∣n and 𝑔(𝑝𝑛) =(𝑝 −1)𝑔(𝑛)g(pn)=(p−1)g(n) otherwise, together with 𝑔 −𝜑 =𝑜(𝑛)g−φ=o(n), force 𝑔 =𝜑g=φ: a nonzero defect keeps a nonzero ratio to the argument along 𝑝𝑗𝑛pjn. The control fails these laws; its full coefficient rank is asserted only at measured finite depths.

Ordinary convergence and Hankel nonvanishing do not contain this denominator estimate. The canonical gap (3) remains the equivalent endpoint; the approximation estimate is one stronger sufficient route.

Antecedents and proof record

Allouche and Shallit introduced 𝑘k-regular sequences . Coons proved that 𝜑φ is not 𝑘k-regular [2]. Martin’s Theorem 1 makes the ratios of totients on any prescribed finite list of pairwise nonproportional affine forms with integer coefficients and positive slopes arbitrarily separated; this implies their linear independence [3]. Section 1.1 gives a direct determinant proof tailored to the sections used here. The basis theorem gives the exact finite-level normal form. Wong [4] proved least-residue irrationality when the denominator base and modulus are the same integer 𝑘 >2k>2; Section 2 fixes base two and classifies dyadic observables. The original question appears in Erdős and Graham [5].

The dyadic finite-level rank 2𝑒 +12e+1, residue-series irrationality, full-depth amplification, canonical equivalence and the positive rank-one floor are in the public snapshot. The unconditional all-base exact-rank theorem is also kernel-checked: its CRT–Dirichlet independence proof does not assume Martin’s theorem. Rank from an independent all-base family remains the reusable conditional factorisation. The canonical gap is the remaining arithmetic endpoint. The historical source links retain 99f4bf47422a. The integral normal form has its ordinary proof above. The periodic transport lemma is checked in PeriodicTotientIndependence.lean; the eventual version follows by the displayed threshold shift. The rational control and the termwise-window and prime-dilation boundaries are proved in ParityPerturbedRationalControl.lean and PrefixValuationAndControlRigidity.lean, respectively. Finite evaluation ranks and the all-level carry lower bound remain distinct. The long record retains the separate continued-fraction bounds 𝑞 ≥239989q≥239989 and 𝑞 >1012038q>1012038 under rationality, alongside the Lean-checked Farey exclusion. Neither implies the universal gap.

The remaining first-harmonic obligation is a four-term pivot budget, not an opening statement of this note. Write

RepivotCenteredCorrelation≤1425𝑋,‖pivotFiberMean‖≤1100𝑋,‖pivotBad‖≤1100𝑋,‖pivotNonSupplier‖≤825𝑋.RepivotCenteredCorrelation≤1425X,‖pivotFiberMean‖≤1100X,‖pivotBad‖≤1100X,‖pivotNonSupplier‖≤825X.

Problem 10 (first-harmonic anti-concentration on supplier fibres). For each ℎ ≥1h≥1, do there exist 𝑠 ≥1s≥1 and 0 <𝜂 <10<η<1 such that, for every 𝑋0X0, there are 𝑋,𝐿X,L with

max(𝑋0,1)≤𝑋,ℎ≤𝐿−𝑠,16(2𝑋+ℎ+𝐿+2)≤2𝐿,max(X0,1)≤X,h≤L−s,16(2X+h+L+2)≤2L,

for which those four bounds hold?

The quantities are defined with the budget condition in the long record. This note does not prove them.

What is checked in Lean
  • For every e ≥ 1, the complete dyadic totient kernel through level e has rational span dimension 2e+1.
  • The rational span of the full dyadic totient kernel is not finite-dimensional; for integer-valued sequence modules this is equivalent to Coons's non-k-regularity and is not an independent contribution.
  • Lean diagonal certificates through t = 82; neither t = 83 nor an unbounded family is supplied.
  • Conditionally: a cofinal strict 9/10 gap for the exact natural prime-tail orbit supplies the existing finite pivot-point escape and hence the reviewed irrationality endpoint.
  • The local s=1 and s=2 squared Möbius Euler-factor identities and the first two prime-power divisor-sum differences.
  • That the two-by-two checkerboard kills separable backgrounds and is unique up to scale under the four row and column cancellations.
  • An abstract four-point divisor-layer identity, stated from its four explicit factorisation hypotheses.
  • An affine completion no-go: every residue class modulo an even modulus has a digit that recentres one carry step.
  • Exact producer and consumer interfaces for prime-ray layer supply, bounded-degree order witnesses, and finite-prime-support escape.
What is not checked
  • The strict prime-tail orbit gap, which is the unproved producer consumed by the conditional endpoint.
  • The packet's sharp parabolic Stern-Brocot cusp theorem and its passage from a geometric x-parameter to the arithmetic totient series.
  • Eventual Hankel nonvanishing for the Möbius-Mersenne power ladder, or its denominator obstruction.
  • The natural-boundary and quasimodular-transcendence steps of the infinite Euler-sieve tower.
  • Polynomial resultant realisability, exact-order finite-field supply, Frobenius freezing, or the Archimedean growth needed by the prime-ray strategy.
  • Unconditional irrationality of the binary totient series.
The formal record: 15 main results, 5 open obligations, 3 Lean modules, finite search evidence, Comparator review

Main results

Statements and boundaries are copied from the corpus record. Registry status: not_registered; the claim registry does not carry these declarations and kernel checking them does not promote them into reviewed public claims

locally proved result; novelty unassessed family: totient_kernel_rank

For every e ≥ 1, the complete dyadic totient kernel through level e has rational span dimension 2e + 1.

This does not prove irrationality of the totient series.

Erdos249257.finrank_totientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq
Lean formalisation of an existing consequence of Coons family: totient_kernel_rank

The rational span of the full dyadic totient kernel is not finite-dimensional.

The declaration is kernel-checked locally, but full-kernel infinite-dimensionality is not an independent contribution of this release; no rationality-to-finite-rank bridge is proved.

Erdos249257.not_finiteDimensional_span_fullTotientKernel
locally proved result; novelty unassessed family: totient_kernel_basis

The full dyadic totient kernel span admits the explicit odd-core-indexed basis.

The basis theorem does not connect rationality to finite kernel rank.

Erdos249257.totientDyadicSectionBasis
formalised unconditional spanning and conditional rank with external independence input family: totient_kernel_all_base_index

Under 2 ≤ k, 1 ≤ e, and linear independence of the explicit canonical all-base family, the actual all-base totient kernel through level e has rational span dimension ke + 1.

The linear-independence hypothesis is the external affine-ordering boundary and is not proved here; this does not prove irrationality of the binary totient series.

Erdos249257.finrank_allBaseTotientKernelThroughLevelFamily_eq_of_linearIndependent
formalised exact visible-lattice normalization identity family: totient_visible_coprime_lattice_mass

The positive coprime Mersenne weights over the visible lattice sum exactly to one, giving the reduced-direction mass behind the fair-coin coprimality form of the totient constant.

This is a rational normalization identity and does not prove irrationality of the binary totient series or settle Erdős #249.

GcdMomentCalculus.tsum_pos_coprime_inv_mersenne_eq_one
formalised exact first-gcd-moment squared-Lambert transfer identity family: squared_lambert_gcd_moments

At base one half, the squared-Mersenne Lambert series weighted by Euler's totient equals the dyadic series of Pillai's gcd-sum function minus n, the exact first gcd-moment transfer.

This exact identity does not prove irrationality of the binary totient series; the constant-weight squared-Lambert irrationality is cited external mathematics, and no Erdős #249 endpoint follows.

GcdMomentCalculus.tsum_totient_div_mersenne_sq_eq_gcd_moment_series
formalised exact Fibonacci/continuant run stability floor family: stern_brocot_run_fibonacci_stability

For every finite defect list e, the height of the corresponding positive Stern-Brocot run word is at least Fr+3 + Fr+1 times the total defect, where r is the number of runs.

This exact combinatorial stability floor does not establish analytic denominator survival, irrationality of the binary totient series, or novelty; no Erdős #249 endpoint follows.

SternBrocotRunGeometry.runHeight_defect_fib_sum_lower
formalised exact Stern-Brocot cylinder telescoping identity family: stern_brocot_cylinder_law

At every positive Stern-Brocot node (a,b), the closed cylinder mass splits exactly into the node's stop mass and the two child cylinder masses.

This exact telescoping recursion and its geometric interpretation do not prove irrationality of the binary totient series or novelty; the #249 endpoint remains open.

GcdMomentCalculus.cylinderMass_split
unconditional progress family: lcm_factor_ideal_shift_algebra_no_go

For every t ≥ 3, a nonzero synthetic dyadic coboundary survives every finite integer shift polynomial while retaining the period-LCM totient factor ideals, exact cleared-prefix cancellation, and uniform state and letter bounds.

The witness is synthetic: it does not assert that its forcing letters are actual totient differences, does not address nonlinear combinations, and leaves the unbounded certificate supply for Erdős #249 open.

Erdos249257.TotientTailPeriodKiller.lcm_factorIdeal_finiteRank_shiftAlgebra_not_sufficient
unconditional synthetic no-go; novelty unassessed family: fixed_precision_transport_no_go

For every positive fixed precision, every finite word of odd valuation-unit symbols and every incoming integer carry state admit a compatible orbit whose successive states stay within the corresponding valuation-unit radii; fixed-precision local signatures therefore do not by themselves exclude finite centred completions.

This is a synthetic finite-word construction with unrestricted incoming/high quotient states. It does not impose the actual totient-difference relation or provide growing-precision/global correlation, and it gives no Erdős #249 endpoint or irrationality result. No novelty or priority claim is made. The one-step and finite-word completion theorems are subordinate mechanisms, not separate families.

Erdos249257.TotientTailPeriodKiller.fixedPrecisionTropicalNoGo
conditional reduction family: actual_lcm_orbit_separation

A cofinal quantitative separation supply for the actual power-two LCM tail orbit implies irrationality of the binary totient series.

The cofinal separation supply is an open premise, stronger than mere non-integrality; this sufficient route is not an equivalence and leaves the punctured/top-edge boundary and the Erdős #249 endpoint open.

Erdos249257.DiagonalFreshLossBridge.PowerTwoOddWindowAffine.irrational_totientSeries_of_actualLcmOrbitSeparationSupply
conditional reduction family: actual_foreign_residue_projection

The finite Möbius residue diagonal splits into projected foreign and divisor channels, every finite stable foreign-tail window obeys a closed geometric bound, and a controlled projection separated from every integer forces the full target to be missed.

This is a conditional finite partition/geometric-majorant reduction with a generic complement-noncancellation consumer. The ControlledForeignProjection analytic bridge and any unbounded separated-projection supply remain unproved; no Erdős #249 endpoint, novelty, significance, priority, or external-review claim is made.

Erdos249257.ActualForeignResidueProjection.scaleFullTarget_miss_of_projected_separation
conditional reduction family: first_harmonic_pivot_decomposition

The exact first-harmonic pivot decomposition and its 9X/10 gap yield a finite certificate whenever the stated PivotBudgetAt bounds hold, and the cofinal pivot-residual-decorrelation socket implies irrationality of the binary totient series.

The four-term decomposition and 9X/10 gap remain conditional on the explicit dyadic-room and PivotBudgetAt hypotheses; the cofinal decorrelation producer is unproved. The fibre/image lemmas do not give global supplier-prime isolation or a prime-distribution estimate, and no Erdős #249 irrationality conclusion is claimed.

Erdos249257.TotientTailPeriodKiller.irrational_totient_series_of_pivotResidualDecorrelation
conditional reduction family: strict_prime_tail_orbit_gap

An 11/100 nonpositive-phase density on arbitrarily late dyadic blocks yields an 89/100 first-harmonic saving and a finite 9/10 gap; alternatively, a cofinal natural-prime tail-orbit strict gap below 9/10 yields adaptive pivot escape and conditional irrationality. The exact initial phase is the scaled-angle character of (2h − 1) times the series, and the strict-gap route is an orbit of repeated squaring from that phase.

The phase-density, cofinal natural-prime strict-gap, associated uniform-margin, and cofinal nonpositive-prime-shift producers remain unproved for the actual totient orbit. Exact phase/integrality equivalence, finite dyadic-root exclusion for 1 ≤ h ≤ 16 and k ≤ 14, and non-dyadicity-to-cofinal-nonpositive-phase implications are classification or finite evidence only; they do not supply density or prime alignment, and the source does not prove actual root entry. This is a conditional reduction only: no unconditional Erdős #249 endpoint, novelty, priority, significance, or external-review claim is made. It is distinct from the finite first_harmonic_pivot_decomposition and actual_lcm_orbit_separation families.

ErdosProblems.Erdos249.irrational_totient_series_of_naturalPrimeTailOrbitStrictGap
locally proved necessary consequence; novelty unassessed family: totient_carry_anti_compression

If the binary totient coefficient series were rational, one positive-multiplier tempered integral carry has dyadic sections uniformly eventually periodic modulo its multiplier and canonical carry-section span dimension at least 2e − 1 for every e.

This is a necessary consequence of rationality only: it gives no contradiction, no finite-rank upper bound for a rationality-supplied carry, and no irrationality proof for Erdős #249. Modulo a divisor of the multiplier, the forcing disappears and the carry becomes geometric, so quotient periodicity alone supplies no finite-ℚ-rank upper bound. The coefficient-side kernel-rank and certificate-equivalence families are not duplicated, and #249 remains open.

Erdos249257.not_irrational_totientSeries_implies_mod_period_and_unbounded_rank

Open obligations

Prove any one of these and the corresponding reduction above becomes unconditional.

  • strict_prime_tail_orbit_gap Prove the cofinal strict 9/10 real-part gap for the exact natural prime-tail orbit, or replace it with another producer for the reviewed pivot-escape endpoint.
  • hankel_denominator_fan_in Prove eventual nonvanishing or a usable denominator obstruction for the Möbius-Mersenne power ladder and connect it to the target value.
  • euler_sieve_limit_theorem Control the infinite Euler-sieve limit strongly enough that finite-stage quasimodularity yields a valid arithmetic obstruction.
  • prime_ray_resultant_supply Realise the layer system by cyclic resultants and prove prime-support escape with the growth estimates needed to contradict a rational carry orbit.
  • stern_brocot_arithmetic_bridge Prove the sharp cusp asymptotic and then supply a non-formal bridge from the geometric parameter regime to the exact totient value.

Finite search evidence

The returned strict-orbit packet reports an exact finite deposit at parameters (147,23), verified through harmonic height 5022. It is research evidence, not a Lean-checked unbounded certificate.
